title: Conveyancing platform launches with direct buyer-seller messaging
summary:
A new conveyancing platform has launched in the UK, offering real-time visibility of property chains to all parties involved in transactions. CentreMove allows buyers and sellers to conduct searches themselves and enables direct communication before offers are made.

title: London agency adopts compliance tech amid rising fines
summary:
A London estate agency has implemented technology to manage increasing rental sector compliance requirements, as non-compliance penalties reach up to £40,000 per offence since May. Brinkleys has integrated an API system to identify high-risk properties before they incur fines.

The post London agency adopts compliance tech amid rising fines appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Build-to-rent starts plunge 84% outside London
summary:
New build-to-rent housing starts in UK regions outside London have fallen by 84% in the year to June 2026, according to data from Savills. Nationally, the number of new build-to-rent homes decreased by 79% over the same period.

title: Two-thirds of Foxtons rental applicants from overseas
summary:
Nearly two-thirds of rental property applicants at London agency Foxtons originate from overseas, according to internal data released by the company. The figures highlight challenges facing letting agents processing applications from tenants without UK-based financial references.

title: UK new homes market faces profitability crisis
summary:
The UK government's target to deliver 1.5 million new homes before the next election appears increasingly unattainable as developers struggle with profitability challenges. Construction costs have increased by £76,000 per home since 2020 according to the Home Builders Federation.

The post UK new homes market faces profitability crisis appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Norfolk estate agent admits £50,000 client fraud
summary:
A Norfolk-based estate agent has pleaded guilty to defrauding landlords and tenants of nearly £50,000 over a seven-year period. Victoria Steele, 51, admitted to 19 counts of fraud by false representation at Norwich Crown Court relating to her operation of eHomes, a Swaffham-based estate and lettings agency.

title: Landlords rush to issue possession claims before deadline
summary:
Landlords accelerated possession proceedings in July to meet the final court deadline for Section 21 notices, resulting in a 28% increase in instructions compared to the previous year. Nearly one-third of all new instructions related to landlords filing court proceedings before the 31 July deadline.

The post Landlords rush to issue possession claims before deadline appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Rightmove reveals most-viewed properties in first half of 2026
summary:
Rightmove has released data on the most-viewed residential properties listed on its platform during the first six months of 2026, revealing a diverse range of homes spanning from £250,000 to £20 million. The properties attracting the highest number of clicks varied significantly in price point and location, though all featured distinctive characteristics that differentiated them from standard listings.

title: UK property transactions stabilise in June after declines
summary:
UK residential property transactions halted a two-month decline in June 2026, reaching 98,700 on a seasonally adjusted basis. The marginal increase of less than 1% from May's 98,460 transactions came despite traditionally stronger spring market conditions, with industry experts citing mortgage rate uncertainty and tax policy concerns as dampening factors.

The post UK property transactions stabilise in June after declines appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: UK housing shortage blamed on planning rules, not land scarcity
summary:
Britain's housing shortage and weak economic growth stem from decades of restrictive planning policy rather than a lack of available land, according to a new report from the Institute of Economic Affairs. The briefing argues that annual housebuilding growth has fallen from 1-2% historically to around 0.5% currently.
